data.narrative:
Frankenburg Technologies is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised €40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 9 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity.

Two triangulation methods anchor this analysis. Stage-progression methodology applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $80M based on the €40M raised proxy. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company Defense & Security cohort produces a $1.0B implied valuation, with the comp set spanning $125M to $3.0B (represented by Dream Security at $3.0B and Allen Control Systems at $2.2B in Series B). The wide peer range reflects material heterogeneity in technology maturity, addressable market scope, and customer traction within the sector.

Triangulation across these two methods supports a valuation range of $68M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $540M. The substantial spread reflects uncertainty around Frankenburg's positioning within the defense-tech maturity curve relative to more advanced Series B peers. Key variables requiring further diligence include customer concentration, revenue traction, and defensibility of technical differentiation within a crowded frontier-defense market.
